verdict.rationale: monday.com has nearby building blocks: it links GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items, can automate scheduled status and performance reports, and lets users create custom agents from a natural-language workflow description. Together these could approximate a per-release summary of shipped work. Nothing in the evidence describes changelog generation or any release-scoped grouping, so this would be a user-built workaround rather than a shipped feature. Missing for 10: native changelog generation, release or version-scoped grouping of shipped items or PRs, documentation of a changelog workflow, and hands-on corroboration.
